title: Exotic Dense Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Egyptian dish featuring pineapple juice and infused oil, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is also anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, infused oil, Dijon mustard, honey, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
